# Short floating table clearing anchor

These are newly generated public controls; no customer content is included.
Word PDF references were exported locally using Word COM. Each DOCX contains a single-page synthetic layout.

- short-pure-break: 12pt one-line floating topic, 14pt clear=all anchor. Its first line extends below the float and must remain in flow. Before/after ink F1: 41.4631% / 100%.
- anchor-shorter-than-table: 10pt clearing anchor, unchanged.
- spacer-before-break: separate spacer between the table and clearing paragraph, unchanged.
- inline-table: no floating position, unchanged.

All controls retain page count and text. The synthetic header relationship and public.png are unused in the document body and contain only generated public artwork.
